summary: Herbalife Ltd. filed an 8-K regarding the issuance of $800 million 7.750% Senior Secured Notes due 2033 by its subsidiaries HLF Financing SaRL, LLC and Herbalife International, Inc. The notes were sold to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S. Interest is payable semi-annually at 7.750%, with maturity on May 1, 2033. The notes are senior secured obligations guaranteed by the company and certain subsidiaries, secured by a first-priority lien on collateral that also secures the existing credit facility. This is a routine debt refinancing or capital-raising transaction, not a special situation such as an acquisition or restructuring. No change of control, strategic review, or activist campaign is involved.
